wars.name: Rostislav Vladimirovich's seizure of Tmutarakan
wars.outcome: 'In 1064 he was displaced by the rival Rus prince Rostislav Vladimirovich' (Gleb Svyatoslavich); Rostislav was poisoned on 3 February 1066 by a Byzantine envoy from Chersonesos.
